==Overview== :;General Information *Brand: Zyxel *Code: Zyxel DX5401 *Product: T54 *Bandwidth: HE40 1148Mbps (2.4GHz), HE160 4804Mbps (5GHz) *Wi-Fi bands: Dual-band 802.11ax :2.4GHz band protocollen: b/g/n/ax :5GHz band protocollen: an/ac/ax *Router/Wi-Fi-modem: Wi-Fi-modem :Automatic Wi-Fi channel selection: Yes :Guest network: No *Security type: WPA, WPA2 *Firewall: Yes
:;Interfaces * WAN: :- 1 RJ11 DSL Line port :- 1 Gigabit Ethernet interface :- SFP cage module for GPON (P2M) :: or Gigabit active fiber (P2P) * LAN: :- 4-port autosensing 10/100/1000Base-T :: and auto MDI/MDI-X Ethernet switch :- 2x FXS POTS interfaces :- 1x USB 3.0 host interface :- Wi-Fi complies with concurrent dual band :: 802.11b/g/n/ax 2.4GHz and 802.11an/ac/ax 5GHz
:;WAN Connection :• Auto WAN sensing ADSL, VDSL2, VDSL2 vectoring, : VDSL2 pair bonding, VDSL2 bonded vectoring, FTTH, 3G/4G :• PPPoE, PPPoA, DHCP Client for Routed IPTV Connection :• Supports multiple WAN connection instances for different service
:;DSL Modem Specifications :• VDSL2 compliance: ITU-T G.993.2 (up to 30MHz profiles) :• VDSL2 Pair-Bonding compliance: :: ITU-T G.998.2 (up to 17MHz profiles) :• UPBO ITU-T G993.2 amendment x :• G.vector ITU-TG-993.5, G.INP ITU-T G998.4 :• 4 wire (2 pair) VDSL2 Bonding and VDSL2 Bonded Vectoring :• ADSL, ADSL2 and ADSL2+ compliance, Supports multi mode standards: :- ANSI T1.413 issue 2, ITU G.992.1 (G.DMT), ITU G.992.2 (G.Lite) :- ITU G.992.3 (G.DMT.bis), ITU G.992.4 (G.Lite.bis), ITU G.992.5
:;Voice Ports :Type: POTS FXS port
:;Voice features :• SIP v2 (RFC 3261), VAD/CNG :• G.168 echo cancellation :• CODECG.711 a/μ (64K), G.726 (24/32K), G.722 :• DTMF detection and generation :• DTMF: In-band and out-of-band :• FAX, modem detection and pass-through :• Call waiting, Call hold/call retrieve :• Call transferring, Call forwarding, Caller ID :• Three way conference, Dynamic jitter buffer :• On hook, off hook and flash detection, DNS SRV
:;Buttons :• 1x restore factory default button (pinhole) :• 1x push button for WPS :• 1x push button for Wi-Fi on/off :• 1x power on/off switch
:;Power adapter :• 200-240 VAC (switched mode) power adapter :• European power plug
